provenance.encodes: DIFC Laws as cited by number and year (e.g. DIFC Law No. 7 of 2018, the Arbitration Law)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the DIFC laws and regulations page and check number/year of each law.

positive.text: DIFC Law No. 7 of 2018 governs arbitration.
Under DIFC Law No. (5) of 2005, Article 10(1) applies.
DIFC Law No. 2 of 2019 Art. 4 applies.

negative: ADGM Law No. 4 of 2020 is separate.

note: DIFC Regulations are not covered: their citation form (title plus 'Regulations' with module numbers) was not pinned down.
